states.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

low.label: Low growth
low.notes: Growth slows to ~4-5%; slow urbanisation; new loads follow the NITI Current Policy path 5 years late.

base.label: Base (reference)
base.notes: IMF/RBI-consistent ~6-6.5% medium-term growth; UN WPP medium population; UN WUP urbanisation; new loads on the NITI Aayog (2026) Current Policy path, interpolated to 2047.

high.label: High growth (Viksit Bharat)
high.notes: ~7.5% growth consistent with developed-economy ambition by 2047; faster urbanisation; new loads reach NITI 2050 levels (Net Zero Scenario for H2/transport) by 2047; H2 export hub.

balanced.label: Balanced transition (recommended)
balanced.desc: Solar+wind lead growth inside grid-balancing limits; coal peaks ~2035, plateaus to 2040, then declines; nuclear scales to ~700 TWh/yr by 2047 (the 100 GW national target); NE hydro developed for export.

accelerated.label: Accelerated decarbonisation
accelerated.desc: Faster storage roll-out allows 65% VRE; nuclear up to 700 TWh/yr by 2047; early coal retirement.

security.label: Energy-security (coal-extended)
security.desc: Supply-chain/storage risk hedged with domestic coal; slower RE build; minimal import exposure.
